entry.description: fix the release scripts continuing after a failed step: `$ErrorActionPreference` does not apply to native commands, so a failing `dotnet`, `git`, `zip`, `gpg` or `mvnw` went unnoticed and the artifacts were packaged, signed and tagged anyway. Both `scripts/build-preview.ps1` and `scripts/build-release.ps1` now set `$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference`. Also fix `scripts/build-preview.ps1` outside Windows, where the artifact paths handed to `gpg` were built with backslashes, which are not path separators on Linux or macOS
